flows.title: Publish your website
steps: Click the Publish button in the top right corner of the Framer editor.
Your site will automatically generate a framer.app domain.
For a site on a PRO plan or higher with staging enabled, go to the Staging tab in the editor to publish your changes to a staging environment.
Once it is ready to go live, switch to the Production tab and press Deploy Latest to publish directly without opening Settings.

flows.title: Review what changed before publishing
steps: Open the project you are about to publish.
Click View Changes to see a list of edits and the profile image of the user who made each one.
Read the list so you are aware of every change before the site goes live.
